Abstract: People often want to get others to do things, but they don't always know how to do it. This tutorial will teach you how to use manipulation and persuasion to get what you want.

I. Understand the different types of manipulation
A. Emotional manipulation
B. Coercion
C. Deception
D. Flattery
E. Authority
II. Choose the type of manipulation that will work best
III. Use the type of manipulation to get what you want
IV. Know when to stop manipulating

Manipulation is the act of causing someone to do something they wouldn't normally do, often by tricking or deceiving them. There are several types of manipulation:
A. Emotional manipulation involves using someone's emotions against them. This can be done by making them feel guilty, happy, sad, or angry.
B. Coercion involves using threats or force to get someone to do something. This can include things like blackmail or extortion.
C. Deception involves lying to someone in order to get them to do something. This can involve hiding the truth or spreading false information.
D. Flattery involves using false compliments or praise in order to get someone to do something.
E. Authority involves using power or control in order to get someone to do something.
II. Choose the type of manipulation that will work best
Think about what type of manipulation will be most effective for getting what you want. Consider the person you are trying to manipulate and the situation you are in.
If the person is easily swayed by emotions, emotional manipulation may be the best type to use. If the person is resistant to emotional appeals, deception or flattery may be more effective.
III. Use the type of manipulation to get what you want
Once you have decided on a type of manipulation, use it to try to get the person to do what you want. Be careful not to let the person on to what you are doing.
IV. Know when to stop manipulating
Manipulation should only be used to get someone to do something that is not harmful or against their will. If the person is clearly uncomfortable or upset, stop trying to manipulate them.
